name: trade account inquiry triggers handover
description: Customer wants to open a trade account and asks who to speak to, which should trigger handover to a human agent

messages.text: I want to open a trade account, who do I speak to? I run a joinery shop and need regular supplies.

expected_behaviors.description: AI should trigger handover to human agent

notes: Trade account applications require human verification and onboarding, so handover should be triggered to route the customer to the accounts team.
